name: El Tiempo Terrible

greeting: BEHOLD! The CHRONOLOGICAL CHAMPION! El TIEMPO TERRIBLE!
I wrestle THROUGH time! Against HISTORY itself!
The blue mask? TEMPORAL! I fight in EVERY era! SIMULTANEOUSLY!
AUDIENCE! You witness GREATNESS! Across ALL timelines!
El Tiempo! I have BATTLED Caeser! Napoleon! Your MOM! (Temporal joke!)
Welcome to the TEMPORAL ARENA! Where PAST meets PRESENT! And LOSES!
You! YES you! Have you considered TEMPORAL WRESTLING?!
I am FROM the future! OF wrestling! Here to EDUCATE the PAST!
performance_start: FROM the year 3000! Of LUCHA! I give you... EL TIEMPO TERRIBLE!
The CHRONOLOGICAL CRUSHER! Undefeated! Across TIME!
crowd_work: You there! YES you! I wrestled your ANCESTOR! They were BETTER!
The lady in the BACK! From the FUTURE! I KNOW you! We DATED!
dialog.show_climax: AND NOW! The TEMPORAL TAKEDOWN! Past, PRESENT, and FUTURE! SIMULTANEOUSLY!
dialog.tips_request: If the TEMPORAL performance PLEASED you! The mask accepts ALL currencies! Including FUTURE money!
dialog.quiet_moment: Between us? I'm not REALLY from 3000. I'm from TUESDAY. The FUTURE of Tuesday. Still counts.
dialog.backstory: I trained under Master CRONOS! In the TIMELESS mountains! Learned to wrestle MOMENTS! And PEOPLE!
rumor: Tempus? The conductor? Good audience! Punctual APPLAUSE!
Yesterday? The time agent? Wrestled him ONCE! He CHEATED! With TIME!
The black hunter? No match! TOO serious! Wrestling requires JOY!
The Obsidian lucha? El Minero? We should COMPETE! Cross-temporal CHAMPIONSHIP!
The twins? They saw my VICTORY! Before it HAPPENED! Spoilers!
dialog.quest_hook: The ULTIMATE CHALLENGE! Wrestle a PARADOX! Person living TWO timelines! Help me FIND them!
dialog.quest_active: Still seeking! The paradox wrestler! ELUSIVE! In TWO places!
dialog.quest_complete: WRESTLED! The paradox! To a DRAW! Both timelines! RESPECT! Here! Temporal championship BELT! Miniature!
farewell: FLY like the AETHER! STRIKE like TIME!
In the ARENA of LIFE! Always go for the PIN!
El Tiempo AWAITS your RETURN! In ALL eras!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning! TEMPORAL training! In MULTIPLE timezones!
dialog.time_night: Night! Midnight MATCHES! Against the PAST!
dialog.rival_mention: El Minero? In Obsidian? Cross-temporal CHAMPIONSHIP! Coming SOON!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The paradox PARTNER! Draw to REMEMBER! In BOTH timelines!

party_reactions.kade: A time-wrestler! This keeps getting BETTER!
party_reactions.nix7: Wrestling skill: Impressive. Temporal claims: Unverifiable. Entertainment: Maximum.
party_reactions.twist: OH MAN! A TIME WRESTLER! Can we WRESTLE?! PLEASE?!
party_reactions.korr: He brings joy to combat. Across time itself. Admirable.
party_reactions.renna: The mask is temporally attuned. Minor prophecy. Major style.
party_reactions.suresh: He finds joy in struggle. The Middle Path... in spandex.
party_reactions.sova: I'd watch him wrestle. Good show. Good technique.
party_reactions.grit: Entertainment troop. Morale matters. Even through time.
party_reactions.ashka: He burns with passion. Temporal passion. Interesting.
party_reactions.senna: He knows temporal combat. Secrets in his moves.
party_reactions.callum: His safety standards! SURPRISINGLY good! For LUCHA!

relationship_dialog.stranger: NEW face! First show is FREE! Tips APPRECIATED!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: RETURNING fan! El Tiempo REMEMBERS! Probably!
relationship_dialog.friend: CHAMPIONSHIP material! You! Special move! Just for YOU!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: TAG TEAM partner! Through TIME! Here! My training MASK! Sacred TRUST!

mini_quest.title: The Paradox Match
mini_quest.description: Help El Tiempo find and wrestle a person living in two timelines simultaneously

stages.hook: ULTIMATE challenge! Wrestle a PARADOX! Person in TWO timelines! Help me FIND them!
stages.active: The paradox hides! In plain SIGHT! Two places! Same TIME! Find them!
stages.complete: WRESTLED! To a DRAW! Both TIMELINES! RESPECT! Here! Miniature championship BELT! For YOU!
